note: Set B is better because it correctly extracts the nail size as '8D' (Set A incorrectly reads '8 8D' from a nearby detail bubble artifact) and captures critical engineering components missed by Set A, such as the '3" WOOD LAG SCREW' and 'GRADE LEVEL 0"'. Set B also provides complete quotes, whereas Set A truncates text (e.g., 'OUGH BOLT'). Both sets make binding errors on the A1 dimensions (Set B attributes them to Railing Attachment, Set A to Deck Module A3), but Set B's data fidelity is higher.
